text:
alana: Hey team — quick pass on the product launch blog draft. I dropped three headline options and a short hero blurb. Want rapid ✅ or ✂️?
micah: dropping my two cents: 2 > 1. Variant 3 feels too technical for the homepage.
ben: can we emphasize latency/cost in the hero? Customers care about predictable cost.
alana: ok, updated hero snip — "Predictable LLM inference: lower latency, lower unit cost" — thoughts?
raj: legal quick note: don't use "lower cost" absolute claims. Suggest "lower unit cost in common configs" or add qualifier.
alana: good call. new hero: "Predictable LLM inference with better unit economics in common configs"
micah: shorter still: "Predictable inference. Better economics."
eva: for webinar hook, I propose: "See a live benchmark: 4x throughput at 60% cost savings vs baseline" — needs legal ok.
raj: that numeric claim needs backup in the blog body and a linked benchmark appendix. Can we add an asterisk and link to methodology?
alana: yes — will add methodology section and appendix link to the evals repo.
marketing-bot: Reminder: publish checklist due in 48h — include UTM template and webinar CTA.
ben: CTA options: 1) Register for webinar 2) Try hosted API 3) Request Dedicated trial. Recommend 2x CTAs: primary webinar, secondary trial.
micah: inbound routing: webinar registrants -> marketo list "product-launch-webinar" + tag "benchmark-interest". Sales notify if company size > $50M ARR.
alana: adding mapping in the doc footer. snippet:
```
webinar_cta -> marketo:list(product-launch-webinar)
register -> lead.tags += benchmark-interest
if lead.company_revenue > 50M -> notify:sales@redwood.com
```
raj: ok on that flow. need to confirm data sharing with Sales.
eva: Can we add a pre-filled question on the form: "Which deployment mode are you evaluating? (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)" — helps routing.
ben: love that. Also include a quick lead scoring rule: +10 if selects Dedicated.
alana: last ask — can product signoff by EOD? @ben @micah
ben: I'll give a pass in 2h.
micah: same.
alana: thanks — I'll push a new draft to the doc and ping again. :thumbsup:
